message.content:
{
 "summary": "Unusual plant behaviour in area 200 has been flagged with an anomaly monitor value of 48.0, where AIT-201 and AIT-201B are the top contributors at 0.58 and 0.41. The root cause is likely a drifting or fouled pH probe misleading the correction loop, as AIT-201 reads 7.20 pH and AIT-201B reads 7.52 pH.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Fouling of the probe by dye, fibre lint or calcium deposits",
  "Reference junction poisoning, or an ageing electrode past its service life",
  "Water in the cable gland or a damaged probe cable"
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Compare the control probe AIT-201 with the check probe AIT-201B",
  "Take a grab sample from the pH correction tank and measure it with the calibrated hand-held meter",
  "Compare the hand-held reading with AIT-201, AIT-201B and the discharge pH AIT-501",
  "Check when each probe was last calibrated in the calibration log and whether it is due",
  "Inspect the probe for coating and the cable for damage"
 ],
 "handover": "Investigated the unusual plant behaviour alarm in area 200 where AIT-201 and AIT-201B disagree (7.20 pH versus 7.52 pH). Perform probe checks and calibration verification per SOP-03 before returning the loop to automatic.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-03 3.2",
  "SOP-03 3.3",
  "SOP-03 3.4",
  "SOP-02 2.4"
 ]
}
